scope: Disposable PGlite/PostGIS, simulated Auth and Storage only; no hosted content writes

results.name: full migrations and isolated owner-only editor workspaces
autosave accepts incomplete drafts without public writes and enforces workspace concurrency
one save creates a new bilingual destination as draft and ignores publication injection
explicit source and translation review never publishes a draft, and licensed media require explicit confirmation
reviewed published corrections update English and Arabic atomically without changing IDs/slugs/status
pending cover, invalid rights and unsafe coordinates roll back every public mutation
verified replacement changes actual media while preserving previous approval and original bytes
cover selection/reordering and removal use only this destination and keep original files
stale dependencies and incomplete payload cannot overwrite manual work
snapshot supplies current bilingual content and delayed requests cannot cross account identities
simple images reject anonymous/non-admin requests and ignore fabricated Google license fields
one original-ownership declaration records the real actor/object and cannot be forged or edited
Replace and Save changes actual published cover without changing any text, translation review or status
verified image reuse and caption edits preserve recorded approval and backend evidence
ownership evidence cannot approve changed object bytes and unknown drafts remain private
